sentences.en: We may give advice, but we do not inspire conduct.
sentences.zh: 我们或许可以提供建议，但不能引导行为。

sentences.en: The nonviolent actions of Martin Luther King inspired many people.
sentences.zh: 马丁·路德·金的非暴力行动激励了很多人。

sentences.en: The following was inspired in part by a true story.
sentences.zh: 以下部分灵感来源于真实故事。

senses.zh: 鼓舞，给...以灵感，影响，使...感动，激发，煽动

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（使…）+spir（呼吸）+e →使…呼吸澎湃→鼓舞
